messages:
opsbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: autoscaler-controller (eu-west-1/gpu-pool-3) reporting 'provision_limit' errors, queue depth rising > 1200 for tenant 'envoy-ai'
Maya (oncall): saw paged alert. confirming impact: embeddings and long-gen routes timing out, customers seeing 503s?
Lee (support): multiple high-sev tickets from Envoy AI — their ingestion pipelines are failing with 'backend_timeout' and high retry rates.
Jonah (ml-infra): checking autoscaler logs, looks like scale-up attempts are hitting cloud quota + our internal per-pool max_concurrent_scale (limit=4).
Priya (eng-runtime): any evidence of heartbeat misses? Last 30m latched failures?
Jonah (ml-infra): yes, controller shows intermittent X509 errors with provisioning agent between 02:08-02:14 UTC, then exponential backoff. kernel: 
```
2023-11-27T02:09:11Z autoscaler ERROR provisioner: allocate failed: quota_exceeded: cannot create gpustream-rt-32
2023-11-27T02:10:05Z autoscaler WARN retrying allocation after 47s
2023-11-27T02:12:40Z autoscaler ERROR pool-scale: reached max_concurrent_scale (4)
```
Diego (sre): queue-growth numbers? need to know severity for customer-facing comms.
Maya (oncall): queue increased from 90 -> 1200 in 24m, tail latency 99th jumped from 200ms -> 18s. Throughput dropped 70%.
Lee (support): Envoy AI says the ingestion job retried 5x before giving up. They requested ETA.
Maya (oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) increase pool max_concurrent_scale 2) manual warm-up VMs in pool 3) route Envoy traffic to alternate region (eu-central)
Priya (eng-runtime): We can flip routing but need a quick compatibility check — model variant parity? Envoy is on model-v2 with kv-cache. eu-central has model-v2-qa, should be compatible but may have slightly different perf.
Jonah (ml-infra): I can push manual scale to +3 nodes if cloud quota allows. Requesting perms to bump max_concurrent_scale to 8 for this pool temporarily.
Diego (sre): I'll open cloud quota ticket in parallel with manual scale; prioritize manual ramp first.
Maya (oncall): @pagerduty can you confirm incident severity and start bridge?
pagerduty: Incident severity set to P1. Bridge started: https://call.bridge/abc123
Maya (oncall): @Jonah go ahead with manual scale and set pool max_concurrent_scale=8. Post the command you run.
Jonah (ml-infra): running:
```
./ctl pool scale --pool gpu-pool-3 --count +3 --concurrent-scale 8 --region eu-west-1
```
Jonah (ml-infra): allocation requests accepted. Cloud provider returned 3 instances pending-provision.
opsbot: Deploybot: started instance bootstrap for gpustream-rt-32 x3 (ids: i-0a12, i-0a13, i-0a14)
Jonah (ml-infra): bootstrap succeeded for 2/3, one still pending due to image pull timeout. retrying.
Priya (eng-runtime): while scale is pending, recommend enabling degraded-mode fallback for Envoy AI: reduce max_workers and enable async prefix-cache to lower per-request GPU usage. Can we push that config?
Maya (oncall): permission to push runtime config?
Priya (eng-runtime): I can patch route-config for tenant 'envoy-ai' to set worker_pool:2 and cache_mode:async. Rolling now.
Priya (eng-runtime): patch applied. Observability: token-rate dropped but average tail latency improving from 18s -> 9s after config change.
Lee (support): informing Envoy customer: sending quick note saying we're mitigating and will provide ETA within 15m.
Lee (support): message sent via customer-notify-bot: "We're actively mitigating a GPU capacity issue affecting ingestion. Temporary fallback applied; some requests may see reduced throughput. We'll update in 15 minutes"
Jonah (ml-infra): last pending instance came up at 02:39 UTC. rgw agent certificate handshake retried and then succeeded. All 3 nodes ready.
opsbot: autoscaler: observed scale target reached. pool size increased +3.
Maya (oncall): monitoring shows queue trending down: 1200 -> 260 in 22m. Throughput returning.
Diego (sre): Customer impact window estimate: 00:08 - 00:44 UTC (36m). Confirm if anyone observed errors after scale?
Lee (support): Envoy reports retries have restarted and backlog is draining. No new 503s after 02:46 UTC.
Maya (oncall): moving to triage->postmortem. Assigning action items now.
Priya (eng-runtime): root cause hypothesis: transient provisioning failures (image pull + cert timeouts) caused controller to backoff; combined with conservative max_concurrent_scale (4) allowed queue to spike before manual intervention. Also runtime config had no graceful degraded-mode switch for heavy tenants.
Jonah (ml-infra): corroborate: cloud API returned intermittent 429/quota_exceeded between 02:08-02:14, then our controller respected backoff and hit internal concurrency cap at 02:12.
Diego (sre): immediate action items (owners):
- increase per-pool max_concurrent_scale to 8 for eu-west-1 pools (Jonah)
- add quota preflight to autoscaler to short-circuit cloud quota errors (Jonah)
- implement degraded-mode auto-toggle for tenants exceeding queue threshold (Priya)
- improve instance bootstrap retry/backoff strategy to surface image-pull issues earlier (Priya + Jonah)
- customer comms post (Lee)
Maya (oncall): timeline + followup: I will write incident summary and schedule postmortem for tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Please add notes and logs to the incident doc.
Lee (support): drafting public-facing postmortem blurb for Envoy; will coordinate with CSM.
Jonah (ml-infra): created internal ticket INFRA-1129 to bump concurrent-scale and add quota preflight. Link: https://issues/INFRA-1129
Priya (eng-runtime): created feature ticket RUNTIME-789 for auto-degraded-mode and config toggles.
Maya (oncall): marking incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Bridge will remain open for 30m.
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged. Owner: Maya (oncall).
opsbot: Note: add logs bundle for 02:00-03:00 UTC to /incidents/1701234567/logs.tar.gz
Maya (oncall): final notes for thread: please upload any adhoc findings to the incident doc, assign to tickets above, and be ready for the postmortem. Action owners, add ETA for fixes to the tickets within 48h.
Lee (support): posted CC to Envoy: "We mitigated the issue; full follow-up and RCA coming in the scheduled postmortem." :thumbsup:
Jonah (ml-infra): leaving final operational note: I'll monitor warm pools for 12h and revert max_concurrent_scale after verified stability.
Priya (eng-runtime): will prototype degraded-mode toggle PR and have a PR ready by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (oncall): thanks all. closing thread in 30m if no regressions.
